title: Towards Healthy Evolution: Exploring the Role and Mechanisms of Human-Agent Interaction in Self-Evolving Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and alignment in self-evolving agents, specifically mitigating 'safety drift' and 'reward hacking.' While it uses safety benchmarks (like HarmBench) and the models generated include brief ethical considerations, the study does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral philosophies, or theology as a core component.
